property_summary: Only the designated DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT can successfully call setL1BlockValues; calls from other senders must revert and must not change any public L1 block fields.

Every call must be `c.f(args);`, `x = c.f(args);`, or `try c.f(args) { ... } catch { ... }` at top level of the single public function; only view calls may sit inside require/assert

property_summary: Either setL1BlockValues call succeeds and updates all public fields to the provided inputs, or it reverts and none of those public fields change.
Calling setL1BlockValues either succeeds and sets every public L1 field to the provided inputs, or it reverts and leaves all those public fields unchanged.

Calling setL1BlockValues can only succeed when msg.sender equals the contract's DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT; if it succeeds then all eight public L1 fields become equal to the provided inputs, otherwise the call reverts and none of those fields change.

If setL1BlockValues succeeds, exactly all eight public L1 fields become equal to the provided inputs; if it reverts, then at least one of those public fields remains equal to its previous value (i.e., a revert cannot simultaneously change every public field to different values).
